answer: Semantic-Similarity Slashing: submissions above 0.85 cosine similarity form a relic cluster; each member must post a nectar bond. The mesa of bonds slash mutually when any cluster member is flagged, so one operator running k near-identical answers loses k bonds per detection. At 0.5 ETH each, a 20-identity farm burns 10 ETH before profiting, making duplication costlier than honest originality. The mechanism works because similarity is cheap to detect but expensive to fake, converting plagiarism into a direct capital loss.
